name: @qu/space-plugins
description: Qu V5: small, optional, reusable app helpers built entirely on @qu/space-core's public API - never a Space/relay-side special case. delivery-status.js tracks a write's local -> relay-synced -> read lifecycle (write-ack + a durable per-reader read-receipts Node); upload-outbox.js is a local-save-then-sync queue for (multiple) file uploads with retry, driven by a caller-supplied local blob store and upload() function; auto-compact.js recompacts a Node on every new member join, closing the 'a member who joins after some history exists can never read that author's writes again' Yjs-ordering gap. Every app doesn't need to reinvent these.
